**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 14.10 Assignment (p0188)**

- **Issue:** The assignment restriction runs one way only. Customer needs IBM's consent to assign; IBM is unrestricted and could assign to a Customer competitor. Customer's carve-out covers only "merger, consolidation or acquisition" — no affiliate transfers, no sale of substantially all assets, and it is not clearly consent-free.
- **Change-of-control check:** No "change of control" language anywhere in the agreement; § 3.3 termination is breach-only, so IBM has no exit or re-pricing right on our change of control. No deletion needed.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** Customer may assign without IBM's consent to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; IBM may not assign without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Customer competitor. Fallback (mutual successor assignment on written notice) offered in the comment.
